questions.text: What is the four-layer architecture that every GenAI SaaS project in this course follows?
options: Relational Database → Redis Cache Layer → REST API → Native Mobile Application frontend
Frontend (HTML) → API Layer (FastAPI) → AI Backend (own or commercial LLM) → Storage
React → Node.js → MongoDB → Redis
Browser → CDN → Lambda → S3
questions.explanation: Every GenAI SaaS project uses: a static HTML frontend served by FastAPI, a FastAPI API layer handling routes and validation, an AI backend (either your own Mini GPT-2 or a commercial API like OpenAI/Gemini/Claude), and a storage layer for persistence.

questions.text: How can you switch between your own LLM and a commercial API like OpenAI in the unified provider?
options: Rewrite all of the application code from scratch by hand every single time you switch
Change the AI_PROVIDER environment variable in your .env file
Install a completely different operating system
It is simply not possible to switch providers
questions.explanation: The unified AIProvider class reads AI_PROVIDER from environment variables. Setting it to 'own', 'openai', 'gemini', or 'claude' switches the backend without changing any application code. This is the strategy pattern in action.

questions.text: What are the 5 steps to customize a GenAI SaaS for your own niche? Select all that apply.
options: Change branding (app name, colors, logo)
Modify system prompts for your domain
Completely rewrite the entire FastAPI framework from scratch all by yourself
Adjust billing tiers and features
questions.explanation: Customization involves: changing branding in index.html, modifying prompts to match your niche (e.g., legal, medical), and adjusting billing tiers. You don't need to rewrite FastAPI — the framework stays the same, only the configuration and prompts change.

questions.text: Which deployment platform is recommended for beginners deploying a FastAPI backend?
options: A self-hosted bare metal server that you rack, wire, and maintain entirely yourself
Railway (easiest: railway login, railway init, railway up)
Building your own private data center
FTP upload to shared hosting
questions.explanation: Railway is the easiest deployment option: three commands (railway login, railway init, railway up) deploy your FastAPI app with automatic HTTPS, environment variable management, and custom domain support. More advanced options include Render, or Vercel (frontend) + Railway (API) split architecture.

questions.text: What are the 5 GenAI SaaS products you will build in this course?
options: Social media bot, speech-to-text, video editor, game AI, email generator
Database manager, file converter, web scraper, email client, calculator
Image gen, video gen, text rewriting, plagiarism & AI detection, OCR
Search engine, recommendation system, fraud detector, sentiment analyzer, and spam filter
questions.explanation: The 5 SaaS products cover real market verticals: visual content creation (image & video), text processing (rewriting & plagiarism detection), and document intelligence (OCR). Each can be deployed and offered commercially using either your own LLM or a commercial API.

questions.text: Care este arhitectura cu patru straturi pe care o urmeaza fiecare proiect GenAI SaaS din acest curs?
options: Bază de date relațională → Strat de cache Redis → API REST → Frontend aplicație mobilă nativă
Frontend (HTML) → Strat API (FastAPI) → Backend AI (LLM propriu sau comercial) → Stocare
React → Node.js → MongoDB → Redis
Browser → CDN → Lambda → S3
questions.explanation: Fiecare proiect GenAI SaaS foloseste: un frontend HTML static servit de FastAPI, un strat API FastAPI, un backend AI (Mini GPT-2 propriu sau API comercial), si un strat de stocare pentru persistenta.

questions.text: Cum puteti comuta intre LLM-ul propriu si un API comercial precum OpenAI in furnizorul unificat?
options: Rescrieți manual tot codul aplicației de la zero de fiecare dată când comutați furnizorul
Schimbați variabila de mediu AI_PROVIDER în fișierul .env
Instalați un sistem de operare complet diferit
Pur și simplu nu este posibil să comutați furnizorii
questions.explanation: Clasa AIProvider unificata citeste AI_PROVIDER din variabilele de mediu. Setarea la 'own', 'openai', 'gemini' sau 'claude' comuta backend-ul fara a modifica codul aplicatiei.

questions.text: Care sunt pasii pentru a personaliza un GenAI SaaS pentru nisa voastra? Selectati toate variantele corecte.
options: Schimbarea brandingului (nume aplicație, culori, logo)
Modificarea prompt-urilor de sistem pentru domeniul vostru
Rescrierea completă a întregului framework FastAPI de la zero de unul singur
Ajustarea nivelurilor de facturare și a caracteristicilor
questions.explanation: Personalizarea implica: schimbarea brandingului in index.html, modificarea prompt-urilor pentru nisa voastra si ajustarea nivelurilor de facturare. Nu trebuie sa rescrieti FastAPI.

questions.text: Ce platforma de deployment este recomandata pentru incepatori care deploiaza un backend FastAPI?
options: Un server bare metal auto-găzduit pe care îl montați, îl cablați și îl întrețineți singuri
Railway (cel mai ușor: railway login, railway init, railway up)
Construirea propriului centru de date privat
Încărcare FTP pe hosting partajat
questions.explanation: Railway este cea mai usoara optiune de deployment: trei comenzi (railway login, railway init, railway up) implementeaza aplicatia FastAPI cu HTTPS automat si suport domeniu personalizat.

questions.text: Care sunt cele 5 produse GenAI SaaS pe care le veti construi in acest curs?
options: Bot social media, speech-to-text, editor video, AI pentru jocuri, generator email
Manager bază de date, convertor fișiere, web scraper, client email, calculator
Generare imagini, generare video, rescriere text, detecție plagiat & AI, OCR
Motor de căutare, sistem de recomandări, detector de fraudă, analizor de sentimente, filtru spam
questions.explanation: Cele 5 produse SaaS acopera verticale reale de piata: crearea de continut vizual, procesarea textului si inteligenta documentara. Fiecare poate fi implementat folosind LLM-ul propriu sau un API comercial.

questions.text: Poia einai i architektoniki tessaron epipedon pou akolouthei kathe ergo GenAI SaaS se ayto to mathima?
options: Sxesiaki Vasi Dedomenon → Epipedo Cache Redis → REST API → Frontend gia Kinitii Efarrmogi Native
Frontend (HTML) → Epipedo API (FastAPI) → AI Backend (idio i emporiko LLM) → Apothikeussi
React → Node.js → MongoDB → Redis
Browser → CDN → Lambda → S3
questions.explanation: Kathe ergo GenAI SaaS chrisimopoyei: ena statiko HTML frontend, ena epipedo API FastAPI, ena AI backend (diko sas Mini GPT-2 i emporiko API), kai ena epipedo apothiikeussis.

questions.text: Pos mporoite na enallaksete metaxi tou dikou sas LLM kai enos emporikou API opos to OpenAI?
options: Xanagraafete olokliro ton kodika tis efarmogis apo tin archi me to cheri kathe fora pou allazete
Allazete ti metavliti perivallontos AI_PROVIDER sto archeio .env
Egkathisttate ena entelos diaforetiko leitourgiko systima
Den einai aplos dynati i enallagi ton parochon
questions.explanation: I eniaia klasi AIProvider diavazei to AI_PROVIDER apo tis metavlites perivallontos. I rithmisi se 'own', 'openai', 'gemini' i 'claude' allazei to backend choris allagi kodika.

questions.text: Poia einai ta vimata gia na prosarmoosete ena GenAI SaaS gia ti diki sas agora? Epilexte ola osa ischyoun.
options: Allagi branding (onoma efarmogis, chromata, logo)
Tropopoiiisi ton system prompts gia ton tomea sas
Pliris xanagraffi olokliroy tou FastAPI framework apo tin archi entelos monoi sas
Prosarmogi epipedon timologisis kai charaktiristikon
questions.explanation: I prosarmogi perilamvanei: allagi branding sto index.html, tropopoiisi ton prompts gia tin agora sas, kai prosarmogi timologisis. Den chreiazzetai na xanagrafete to FastAPI.

questions.text: Poia platforma deployment synisttatai gia archarious pou kanoun deploy ena FastAPI backend?
options: Enas aftofiloxenoumenos bare metal server pou syntireite kai diacheirizeste entelos monoi sas
Railway (eukolo: railway login, railway init, railway up)
Kataskeyi tou dikou sas idiotikou kentrou dedomenon
FTP upload se koinochriisto hosting
questions.explanation: To Railway einai i pio eukoli epilogi: treis entoles (railway login, railway init, railway up) kanoun deploy tin FastAPI efarmogi me aftomato HTTPS kai ypostirixi custom domain.

questions.text: Poia einai ta 5 proionta GenAI SaaS pou tha ftiaxete se ayto to mathima?
options: Bot koinonikon diktyon, speech-to-text, epexergastis video, AI paichnidion, genniitria email
Diacheiristis vasis dedomenon, metatropeas archeion, web scraper, email client, arithmomichani
Dimiourgia eikonon, dimiourgia video, anadiatypposi keimenou, anichnefsi logoklopis, OCR
Michani anaziitisis, systima systaseon, anichneytis apatis, analytiis synaisthimaton kai filtro spam
questions.explanation: Ta 5 proionta SaaS kalypptoun pragmatikes agores: dimiourgia optikou periechomenou, epexergasia keimenou kai noimossyni engrafon. Kathe ena mporei na anapticchthei chrisimopoiontas to diko sas LLM i emporiko API.
